_comment: Every language RASTA offers. English is the source; every other catalogue is drafted with Sarvam Translate into apps/client/i18n/<code>.json. `code` is the BCP-47 tag used for lang and Intl; `sarvam` is the Sarvam Translate language code; `dir` is the default text direction, which a generated catalogue's _meta.dir overrides once its actual script is known.
